rows.rewrite: net billing price for kWh supplied by prosumer to licensee
rows.answer:
Under a net‑billing arrangement the kilowatt‑hours that you export to the licensee are billed at the **national average energy purchase price** [S1].  

If you have a distributed‑generator agreement that was executed under the repealed Net Metering Regulations, the savings clause says you are billed at the **national average power purchase price** until that agreement expires, and for any future renewals you will be billed at the **national average energy purchase price** [S6].

[S1] Prosumer Regs 2026, reg. 14(1), p. 6
[S6] Prosumer Regs 2026, reg. 21(2), p. 7

rows.rewrite: distributed generation facility capacity greater than sanctioned load net metering
rows.answer:
Your solar system’s capacity may not be larger than the sanctioned load of your premises; the capacity of a proposed distributed generation facility shall not exceed the sanctioned load, although the Authority may revise the capacity by notification [S1].  

The earlier rule that allowed up to one‑and‑a‑half times the sanctioned load was in the Net Metering Regulations 2015 but it has been repealed by the Prosumer Regulations 2026, so it no longer applies except under the savings‑clause for agreements already executed before the repeal [S4][S6].

[S1] Prosumer Regs 2026, reg. 3(2), p. 2
[S4] NM amendment 2018, text, p. 1 (repealed)
[S6] Prosumer Regs 2026, reg. 21(2), p. 7

rows.rewrite: DISCO meter reading procedures detection bill
rows.answer:
Meter reading of all DISCO consumers is done on a routine monthly basis by DISCO staff, with consumers divided into batches and sub‑batches so that meters in a batch are normally read on the same dates each month [S2]. For connections that have an AMR system, a separate batch is created and billing is carried out remotely according to a schedule made by DISCO [S1]. If a force majeure prevents actual reading, the consumer may submit a meter‑reading snapshot to DISCO or DISCO may issue a provisional bill based on last year’s or average consumption of the previous eleven months, whichever is lower, with the final bill issued after normalization [S3].

[S2] Consumer Service Manual 2025, clause 6.1.1, p. 45
[S1] Consumer Service Manual 2025, clause 6.3, p. 48
[S3] Consumer Service Manual 2025, clause 6.1.1.1, p. 45
